Main function.description: Boilerplate for a HOSC entry-point file: package declaration + main()

If.description: If statement (no parentheses required around the condition)

For (C-style).description: C-style for loop — parentheses are required for this form, and the init clause must use var

For (bare condition).description: Bare-condition for loop, equivalent to a while loop

While.description: While loop (no parentheses required around the condition)

Switch.description: Switch statement — no fallthrough, each case runs until the next case/default/}

Prints (raw string).description: Print a literal, possibly multi-line raw string verbatim (for ASCII art) — must be prints[ + backtick raw string + ]
